fields.description: Stored checksum word: the u32 LE sum of all 118 save-buffer words (offsets 0..471) always equals 0x12345678. Written in FUN_0801bfcc as 0x12345678 minus the sum of words 1..117; verified on load in FUN_0801bef0. Custom constant-sum algorithm, so it is a typed field, not a checksums entry.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bfcc zeroes word 0, sums 0x76 words and stores _DAT_0801c070(0x12345678) - sum at buffer offset 0; FUN_0801bef0 rejects the save unless the 0x76-word sum equals 0x12345678. Baseline rev8-logical words sum to exactly 0x12345678.
fields.name: record_checksum

fields.description: Record table 0, rank 0 best score. New results are inserted here in descending order by FUN_08010a44 and rendered by FUN_08010d34.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd68 defaults table rows at buf+8+row*0x1c to (7-col)*1000 (baseline: 7000 here); FUN_08010a44 shifts *(buf+8+col+row*0x1c) down on a new record; FUN_08010d34 draws *(u32*)(buf+8+col*4+table*0x1c).
fields.name: best_score_t0_r0

fields.description: Record table 0, rank 1 best score. Same insert/display path as rank 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08010a44 shifts the buf+8+table*0x1c row on insert; FUN_08010d34 draws each of the 7 u32 ranks; FUN_0801bd68 defaults this rank to 6000 (baseline: 6000).
fields.name: best_score_t0_r1

fields.description: Record table 0, rank 2 best score. Same insert/display path as rank 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08010a44 shifts the buf+8+table*0x1c row on insert; FUN_08010d34 draws each of the 7 u32 ranks; FUN_0801bd68 defaults this rank to 5000 (baseline: 5000).
fields.name: best_score_t0_r2

fields.description: Record table 1, rank 0 best score (second of 6 record tables, row stride 0x1c).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd68 initializes 6 rows at buf+8+row*0x1c (baseline row 1 repeats 7000..1000 at 0x24); FUN_08010a44 indexes rows by *0x1c and FUN_08010d34 renders table param_1 at buf+8+param_1*0x1c.
fields.name: best_score_t1_r0

fields.description: Record-table/mode selector: FUN_08010a44 dispatches through a jump table when this byte is below 5, otherwise it runs the record-insert path. Default 2.
fields.evidence: FUN_08010a44 reads *(buf+0xb4) < 5 to select a handler; FUN_0801bd3c writes default 2 at buf+0xb4 (baseline: 2).
fields.name: table_selector

fields.description: Table 0 rank 0 holder initials (3 characters, default AAA). Shifted with the score row on insert and rendered on the records screen.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd68 writes 0x41 triplets per entry at buf+0x12f+row*0x15+col*3 (baseline 0x12f..0x131 = AAA); FUN_08010a44 shifts entry bytes at 0x12f/0x130 bases on insert; FUN_08010d34 renders entry text from the 0x12f/0x130 region.
fields.name: entry_initials_t0_r0

fields.description: Table 0 rank 0 entry digit (0-9), drawn next to the initials on the records screen.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd68 stores func_0x0801ea88(0,10) random digits at buf+0x105+col+row*7 (baseline 0x105 = 0); FUN_08010d34 draws one digit byte per rank from that per-table region.
fields.name: entry_digit_t0_r0

fields.description: Table 0 rank 0 entry-valid flag, default 1. One flag byte per record-table cell.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd68 writes 1 for all 42 cells at buf+0x1ad+col+row*7 (baseline 0x1ad = 1, 42-byte run of 0x01 ending where the 0x22 sentinel sits at 0x1d7).
fields.name: entry_flag_t0_r0

fields.description: Four gameplay default bytes (baseline 02 3c 01 01, i.e. 2, 60, 1, 1). Written once by the defaults routine; no gameplay writer was recovered, so they are documented as observed.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd3c writes buf+0xb4..0xb8 = 02 02 3c 01 01 (this field covers the last 4 of those bytes at 0xb5..0xb8, baseline matches exactly).
fields.name: config_b5_b8

fields.description: Ascending order sub-table (baseline 00 01 02 03) written by the defaults routine alongside the 0x22-sentinel setup.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd68 writes buf+0xb9..0xbc = 00 01 02 03 (baseline matches exactly); neighboring bytes buf+0xc0/c1 = 04 01.
fields.name: rank_order_b9_bc

magic_signatures.description: Record-valid sentinel: FUN_0801bef0 only accepts the save when the byte at buffer offset 200 is 0x0c (written by FUN_0801bd68).
End-of-record sentinel: FUN_0801bef0 only accepts the save when the last buffer byte at offset 0x1d7 is 0x22 (written by FUN_0801bd68).
